sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Genjutsu (Visual, Tactile, Unaware), Yin Release

system.description:
You bend Yin Release chakra around yourself creating a repeating set of scenarios your enemy must adapt to overwhelming them making them lose sight of the present, as they are stuck in a loop fighting against the same circumstances that got them here. The target creature must make a Wisdom saving throw.

Success: The affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effect.

Failure: On the affected creatures turn, they must spend their movement, moving to the last space they occupied before their current position, and they must spend their Bonus Action, repeating the same activity they used it for the previous turn. They repeat their saving throw at the end of each of their turns.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they must spend their Action, repeating the same activity they used on their previous turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1.
